facts.clause: Spider Form: Basic attacks deal bonus magic damage and restore health to Elise.
Spider Form: Lunges at an enemy and deals damage based upon how low their Health is.
Human Form: Stuns the first enemy unit hit and reveals them if they are not stealthed.
Transforms into a menacing spider, reducing her attack range in exchange for Move Speed, new abilities, and a Spiderling swarm that will attack her foes.
